name: Milas-Bodrum Airport

runway.v: runway 10L/28R 3,000 m x 45 m; runway 10R/28L (2,940 m x 45 m) is used as a taxiway by civil aircraft, as a runway only in emergencies or when 10L/28R is closed for maintenance

hours.v: aerodrome operator, air traffic services, fuelling and handling 24 hours

fuel.v: Avgas 100LL and Jet A-1, by hydrant and tankers
fuel.quote: 2 Fuel and oil types Avgas-100 LL, Jet A1

max_aircraft.v: general aviation parks on apron positions 25-58, maximum wingspan 31 m
max_aircraft.quote: Parking positions 25-58 on the Apron are used for General Aviation Aircraft (Max Span 31 M).

noise.v: at docking stands the APU must be off within 5 minutes of parking and may be started 15 minutes before estimated start-up; departures by Chapter 3 aircraft fly NADP-2
noise.quote: At docking stands, APU must be switched off within 5 min after parking

notes: Read DHMI AIP Turkey AD 2 LTFE (English PDF): AD 2.3 page AIRAC AMDT 03/26 (19 Mar 2026), AD 2.4 AMDT 06/25 (12 Jun 2025), AD 2.12 page AMDT 11/24 or 01/24, AD 2.20 pages AMDT 04/26 and 05/26. All AD 2.3 services are H24; no curfew or night restriction is stated, so none is recorded. Hangar space for visiting aircraft 'Not Available'. Training landings and take-offs are not permitted 15 Apr-15 Oct (AD 2.20). Slot rules not stated in AD 2; the DHMI slot page for Bodrum was not read. IATA code not printed in the AIP.
